scope: Reconcile DWG/DXF peer claims by evidence layer: document codecs, DXF entity models, GIS projections, target consumers, and geometry semantics; refine optional comparator and fast-gate selection.

method.kind: Static review of primary project documentation/source pages and the current local implementation plan
method.sourcePinning: GitHub master/main, project API references, and stable GDAL documentation are mutable; exact revision/release/options must be captured before any runtime comparator use.
method.evidenceRule: Separate container/version parsing, typed field and graph preservation, writer/readback acceptance, projected geometry, and exact B-rep semantics. Project matrices and class registration do not promote support.

comparators.evidence: The project documents broad DWG/DXF parsing, writing and conversion, while also listing advanced/unstable/undertested classes and AcDs record limitations. Published README/manual/packaging statements differ on writer boundaries, making release pinning material.
comparators.planUse: Optional pinned comparator at a composed stage, recording version, direction, object route, per-handle typed/raw/skipped result and diagnostics. Not a per-slice dependency or semantic kernel.

comparators.evidence: Published capability tables separate DXF and DWG reader/writer by AC version; read APIs expose notifications. This is route/version inventory, not a per-family preservation guarantee.
doesNotEstablish: writer acceptance for every entity/object family
comparators.planUse: If selected for a specific unresolved question, pin a release/source SHA and record notifications, per-source-handle outcomes, BLOCK/INSERT closure, target write and independent reopen separately.

comparators.evidence: The exposed model includes ordinary geometric records including SOLID, 3DFACE, VERTEX and 3D polylines. That supports bounded explicit-entity comparison only.
comparators.planUse: Keep in the common entity/consumer lane; distinguish SOLID from 3DSOLID and do not count as an independent ACIS semantic oracle without source-lineage review.

role: optional raw modern ASM carrier comparator
comparators.evidence: The driver tessellates curves, expands/merges blocks depending on options, projects entities into OGR geometries, and documents unsupported types and missing OCS/elevation cases. GDAL 3.12 adds Binary DXF input. AC1027+ extensible mode exposes raw ASM data and a transform without constructing OGR solid geometry.
comparators.planUse: Optional composed comparison only, with GDAL version, input AC code and all raw/block/merge/3D options captured. Score only explicitly supported projected profiles; never treat a missing OGR feature as proof of source loss.

comparators.evidence: The repository states that it is ported from ACadSharp and identifies an upstream ACadSharp commit for comparison.
comparators.planUse: Deduplicate peer evidence by parser source family; an independently tested port can be a differential implementation but not an independent vote.

implementationReadinessChanges: Retain all affected 2D LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 callback and DXF compatibility checks; 3D peer gaps do not weaken the 2D contract.
For explicit polygonal geometry, compare wire tags, WCS/OCS placement, connectivity, visibility/crease fields, owner/container and following-record framing before any lossy geometry projection.
Keep SOLID, 3DFACE, polyface/MESH and ACIS 3DSOLID as distinct feature families.
Complete local ACIS/ASM carrier, transform, size, index, handle and owner closure before optional GDAL or other external carrier checks.
At a composed external checkpoint, select at most one document parser relevant to the unresolved format-stage question and keep the expected handle/content manifest independently authored.
Per-slice validation remains changed strict targets, the owning focused CTest, lc3_compat_check and git diff --check; broad peer/native validation remains at the existing composed gates.
